notes:
Background: Product org building customer success + in-app help features, moving from heuristics to embeddings+reranking for doc search and support triage. Started on Hosted API to iterate quickly; now evaluating Dedicated for predictable throughput and data residency. POC scope: 5M doc embedding index (annoy/hnsw) + live reranking over top-K, plus a light-weight chat assistant for power users. Latency targets: 100-250ms tail for reranking path, 300-500ms for interactive chat. Cost sensitivity: mid-market; wanting clear unit economics before committing to Dedicated. Explicit ask from VP Eng: "We need a repeatable model for cost/provisioning — show us 12-month run-rate and impact of batching/caching/quantization."

POC notes: using 3 sample tenants, mixed query load with peaks ~60 qps (embedding lookups) and sustained 10-15 qps for chat. Current Hosted runs show median latency ~180ms but token cost higher than expected. Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations: batching windows, prefix/KV caching for chat, quant profiles (4-bit / int8) for reranking models, and fallback routing to cheaper model variants during bursts.

Security/Compliance: Must pass SOC2 evidence review, SSO/SAML integration required, audit logs retention 1 year, data residency preference: US + EU. Legal flagged encryption at rest (KMS) and no data sharing with third parties.

Commercial: initial preference for Dedicated (monthly committed) if unit costs + SLA match. Requested pricing scenarios for: hosted-only (pay-as-you-go), dedicated-reserved (3 sizes), and a hybrid (hosted for dev + dedicated for prod). Procurement timeline: internal procurement window opens 2026-05; legal wants standard EULA + DPA.

Quotes and client color: "If we can't get below a $0.003/token equivalent for high-throughput reranking, this will be hard to justify vs. in-house GPU ops" — VP Eng. Engineering lead emphasized: "Show us actual token-level breakdowns and the impact of caching on p50/p95 costs."

poc_summary: POC goals: validate reranking latency under 250ms p95 with 60 qps burst; evaluate embedding index refresh costs at 5M docs; show 30-60% unit-cost improvement with batching + KV caching + quantization. Deliverables: sample cost model (tokens/second, tokens/month, $/1M tokens), Dedicated sizing recommendation, fallback routing plan, and runbook for rollouts. Success criteria: product team signs off on predicted 12-month TCO and Dedicated ROI > 25% vs hosted-only for projected production load.
